source_match.path: UpdateTexture maps only upload_size on a dedicated staging allocation, then flushes VK_WHOLE_SIZE. Whole-size means through the current mapping end, not automatically through the allocation end. This matches the observed validation failure. The generic UploadTexture and vertex/index mappings share the same dedicated-allocation range issue; the patch covers all four map calls.
source_match.allocation_proof: Each touched memory handle is separately allocated and bound at offset0 in this backend, not a suballocation inside a shared allocator block.
source_match.causality_limit: No stack trace was captured. The mapping values, Present thread and inspected upload code establish the range defect, not that it caused the original later RADV device loss. The first validation error can mask later command/resource errors.

correction.change: Map each dedicated upload/vertex/index/atlas memory object from offset0 through its allocation end using VK_WHOLE_SIZE; use a matching whole-range flush for the generic upload too.
